summary: Pre-Vote update modeled (MODEL_CHANGE_REQUIRED); 16 fresh traces validate; two update-introduced defects found by model checking and reproduced end-to-end.
validation_limits: All TLC campaigns are bounded (3 nodes, MaxTerm 2, MaxLogIndex 4, small fault/election/Pre-Vote/membership budgets, <=5 messages) and stopped at a 30-minute budget with non-empty queues: LIMITED_COVERAGE, not exhaustive.

Engine-level traces: the RaftCore correlation check, RPC timeouts, default-network fallback grant and runtime enable_pre_vote toggle are covered by code review, the model and end-to-end tests, not by trace replay.
Follower-side membership change through replication and timing (timeouts, tick rate limits) are abstracted in the model.
Prior suite defect repaired: LogLE treated absent logs as different, so the prior 3-voter MC.cfg could never elect a leader.
The pinned nightly toolchain is unavailable; the stable toolchain was used for all builds and tests.
No old-revision control: the reproductions use APIs (Config::enable_pre_vote, trigger().elect(bool)) that do not exist in the baseline.

findings.title: A timer Pre-Vote round outlives the node's own leader establishment and demotes the new leader
findings.cause: establish_leader/become_leader keep pre_candidate and handle_pre_vote_resp calls elect() without the timer's leader/voter checks.
findings.trigger: With Pre-Vote enabled the election timer starts a Pre-Vote round on a Candidate whose election then wins; a late Pre-Vote grant for that round arrives.
findings.consequence: The healthy new leader steps down to Candidate at term+1 keeping its Leader object; RaftCore panics on the leader.vote >= state.vote assertion (debug builds).

premises: Pre-Vote is enabled (Config::enable_pre_vote = Some(true) or runtime toggle).

Vote responses can arrive after the Candidate's election timer fired but within the vote RPC timeout (vote persistence/command-drain latency exceeds election_timeout - election_timeout_min plus tick phase).

findings.title: Pre-Vote responses of an earlier round are counted by a later round with the same probe; after a membership change grant_by panics
findings.cause: does_pre_candidate_vote_match correlates Pre-Vote responses only by the probed leader id, which successive rounds at the same term share.
findings.trigger: Two operator Pre-Vote rounds at the same term with a grant of the first still in flight; for the crash, a membership change removing that responder in between.
findings.consequence: The later round counts the stale grant; with the responder removed, Candidate::grant_by panics and the RaftCore dies.

premises: Operator-triggered Pre-Vote rounds are not rate limited.
A Pre-Vote response can be delayed up to election_timeout_min.
